ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. going
   C. goed
   D. went

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

4. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

6. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

7. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

9. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

10. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

11. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

12. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. quickly

13. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

14. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
